name: American Mahjong at the J (Stroum Jewish Community Center)
description: Hosted by the Stroum Jewish Community Center (SJCC) on Mercer Island. Own-page quote: "Play American mahjong from 6-8:30 pm at the J!" Free drop-in play (not instructional); SJCC also lists beginner mahjong classes.
address: 3801 East Mercer Way, Mercer Island, WA 98040
schedule: Mondays 6:00-8:30 PM (evening) and 1:00-3:00 PM (daytime) American Mahjong free play at SJCC Makom

name: Seattle Mahjong Club Group
description: Own Meetup page says it teaches the Taiwanese version: "Whether you have played Chinese, Japanese, American, or any other variation of mahjong, we'd like to show you how to play Taiwanese version." Not an American/NMJL group.
